name: Curtis Stigers - Copenhagen Jazz Festival - Amager Bio
description:
420 kr. i forsalg / 435 kr. i døren
Døre kl. 19 / Show kl. 20
Unummererede siddepladser
▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄▄

Curtis Stigers er en amerikansk sanger, saxofonist, guitarist og sangskriver. Stigers begyndte sin musik karriere som teenager ved at spille med i jazz-, rock- og blues-grupper, og ved at modtage undervisning i klarinet og saxofon på high school i Boise.

Ud over en 30-årig karriere, millioner af solgte albums og en række hitsingler har han dedikeret sig til kunstnerisk udvikling og til at tilføre nye sange til The Great American Songbook. Han har samtidig redefineret moderne jazzvokal.

Som sangskriver har Stigers arbejdet med legender som Carole King, Barry Mann og Beth Nielsen Chapman. Hans talent førte også til en Emmy-nominering for at skrive og synge titelmelodien til tv-serien Sons of Anarchy. Hans karakteristiske stemme – både legende og melankolsk – har sikret ham samarbejder med Al Green, Elton John, Eric Clapton, Bonnie Raitt og mange flere.

Efter at være blevet opdaget af Clive Davis i en New York-restaurant, udgav han et debutalbum, der solgte over 1,5 millioner eksemplarer med hits som I Wonder Why. Hans cover af Nick Lowes Peace, Love and Understanding var med på The Bodyguard-soundtracket, der har solgt over 45 millioner eksemplarer.

Curtis Stigers' nyeste album hedder 'Songs From My Kitchen Volume 1' og udkommer 21. marts 2025. Forud for albumudgivelsen har han frigivet singlen 'Good To Know You.'

description:

Koncerten er en del af Copenhagen Jazz Festival 2025.

• Døre: kl. 19
• Koncert: kl. 20

Tilmeld dig Bremen Teaters Nyhedsbrev:
https://www.brementeater.dk/nyhedsbrev
——————————————
Den fandenivoldske danske trio IBRAHIM ELECTRIC har i løbet af de senere år markeret sig som et af de mest originale og populære nye orkestre på den europæiske musikscene. Deres energiske, udadvendte og til tider provokerende musik har henrykket folk overalt, hvor de er kommet frem.

Bestående af guitarist Niclas Knudsen, trommeslager Stefan Pasborg og Hammond-organist Jeppe Tuxen har trion spillet koncerter på klubber og festivaler i omkring 25 forskellige lande på 4 forskellige kontinenter, lige fra Shanghai til Vancouver, fra Monte-Carlo til Moskva og fra Varanger til Casablanca. Musikalsk bevæger trioenb sig inden for funk, surf, afrobeat, jazz, 50'er rock 'n' roll, soul, blues, disco m.m... Alle disse musikalske referencer bliver blandet sammen til den klassiske "Ibrahim Electric-gryderet", hvor grundelementerne stadig - ligesom da bandet startede for 10 år siden - er energi, power, virtuositet og spilleglæde!

De tre medlemmer har også skabt sig et navn på den danske og internationale musikscene, både i egne projekter og som ”side men” hos forskellige kunstnere i ind- og udland, og ingen andre end denne trio kan spille med denne høj- energi og samtidig bevare det virtuose og legende i musikken.

’Ibrahim Electric losser mås, så det synger i hypofysen, for sikke et kraftoverskud disse tre unge musikere lægger for dagen... det her er bedre end Viagra!” – Information

”Dans, opfør dig vanvittigt, headbang – eller ryg noget græs og spis nogle sjove svampe. Lige meget hvordan du lytter til Ibrahim Electric, bliver du nød til at indrømme, at de har en effekt på din krop som alle tiders total-orgasme!” – Jazz Special, DK

”Gets under your skin and into your blood faster than a Ganges parasite... with their irresistible guitar motifs and cantering percussion, Ibrahim Electric could be the soundtrack for a spaghetti western in Mali” – All About Jazz, USA

name: GinmanBlachmanDahl plays GinmanBlachmanDahl – CJF 2025
description:
GinmanBlachmanDahl er et uomgængeligt fyrtårn på den danske jazzscene og regnes som en af landets bedste trioer. Under Copenhagen Jazz Festival 2025 får publikum selvsyn for sagen, når trekløveret optræder i DR Koncerthuset

GinmanBlachmanDahl plays GinmanBlachmanDahl – CJF 2025
Lørdag d. 5. juli, kl. 20:00 @ DR Koncerthuset, Studie 2
Billetter: https://bit.ly/cjf2025gbd

●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●

Trioen GinmanBlachmanDahl er på mange måder en unik institution på den skandinaviske og europæiske jazzscene. De har spillet sammen i over 30 år, og bag navnet gemmer sig tre af Danmarks største musikalske personligheder - bassist Lennart Ginman, trommeslageren Thomas Blachman og pianisten Carsten Dahl. Sammen var de det første danske jazznavn, der nogensinde blev udgivet på det legendariske Verve Records i begyndelsen af 00'erne.

De har i ægte fællesskab opnået status som en af landets mest populære trioer gennem en afgrundsdyb musikalsk tillid til magien i deres fælles improvisationer. De tre medlemmer bevæger sig altid frit mellem komposition og improvisation i et åbent univers, der nærmer sig musikalsk telepati, mens deres dybe kendskab til jazztraditionen tilfører det nødvendige swing og farver deres øjeblikkets musik med både inderlighed og farlighed.

GinmanBlachmanDahl udgav i 2024 deres seneste, anmelderroste album, “What’s To Come”, der blandt andet modtog maksimale seks stjerner i GAFFA. Med deres frygtløse udgangspunkt, som omfatter hele jazzens historie fra standardrepertoire til kompleks kompositionsmusik, er der grund til at glæde sig, når GinmanBlachmanDahl indhyller DR Koncerthuset i forfinet sammenspil.

name: Cole Pulice (US) | Copenhagen Jazz Festival
description:
Cole Pulice (they/them) is an American saxophonist, composer, and improviser known for crafting immersive, atmospheric soundscapes. With their new album Land’s End Eternal—a six-part suite of pastoral chamber jazz—they invite audiences into a hypnotic concert experience where the lines between acoustic and electronic music gently dissolve.

Pulice, who has performed at Pitchfork Music Festival and Rewire among others, blends signal-processed saxophone with layers of electric guitar and soft choral arrangements. The result is tranquil, dreamlike, and experimental—ideal for those seeking sonic exploration and moments of reflection.

Released on the influential experimental label Leaving Records, the album marks a unique opportunity to hear an international voice in modern jazz and ambient music live in concert.

Med udgangspunkt i deres nye album Land’s End Eternal – en seksdelt suite af pastoral kammerjazz – inviteres publikum ind i en hypnotisk koncertoplevelse, hvor grænserne mellem akustisk og elektronisk musik opløses.

Pulice, som har spillet på festivaler som Pitchfork Music Festival og Rewire, arbejder med signalbehandlet saxofon, lag af elektrisk guitar og bløde korflader. 

Musikken er rolig, drømmende og eksperimenterende – perfekt for dig, der søger fordybelse og lydlig fornyelse.

name: Veronica Rud Duo | Copenhagen Jazz Festival
description:
JAZZ IN HUSET’S COURTYARD
You can experience several free jazz concerts and enjoy a cold draft beer in HUSET’s Courtyard during the entire Copenhagen Jazz Festival.
It takes place 05.07-06.07 + 08.07-13.07 at 15:30 + 17:00 + 18:30

Veronica Rud Duo

Veronika Rud is a singer and composer from Aarhus who has made a name for herself with her debut EP 'Mens Jeg Venter', which has attracted a lot of attention on P8 JAZZ.

She invites listeners into an atmospheric musical universe where inner life is shared with  honesty and presence. With great love for musical traditions, filled with elements from the modern Nordic jazz scene, R'n'b and folk music, she paves the way for the music's very own agenda.

In a univers where the soft and energetic expression merges and through curious improvisations and playful rhythms, one is reminded of the traditional jazz scene while new musical connections emerge.

Veronika's music takes the listener on a journey, that will hopefully touch and connect people across different backgrounds and experiences!

Genres: soul, vocal jazz, contemporary

Visa Versa is a Danish flamenco/jazz/Latin trio featuring Anders Keiding on piano, Lasse García on flamenco guitar, and singer/percussionist Emilio ‘El Perito’.

Their music blends the sounds and rhythms of flamenco, tango, son, and bolero with the unique tones of Nordic musical heritage. The trio interprets pieces by Chick Corea, Astor Piazzolla, Egberto Gismonti, Lars Jansson, Erik Satie, and more.

description:

Tranquebar

In its early years, Tranquebar helped revive the tradition of street musicians in Copenhagen. From the summer of 2011 onwards, Tranquebar has played countless unannounced intimate concerts at pubs and street corners.

The first took place at Fingerbøllet's pool table in Christianshavn and since then there have been many late nights and early mornings at legendary watering holes such as Lille Peter, Stefanshus, Riesen, Karusellen, Lord Nelson and Børges Bodega - in addition to the regular jazz festival gigs at HUSET.

Tranquebar has released several EPs and two albums. The latest album 'Ø' was recorded on the four Danish islands of Sejerø, Endelave, Møn and Fejø and has received critical acclaim and has been played on various international radio stations.

Genres: fusion, world

name: Paradise Jazz: Lea Foxman + Toftemark/Fryland Quartet | Copenhagen Jazz Festival
description:
The 21-year-old vocalist Lea Foxman is quickly making her mark as a new addition to the Danish jazz scene.
Her interest in rhythmic music began after seven years of education in the classical tradition, and it wasn't long before she was studying singing, fronting several youth big bands and creating her own projects. Tonight, she has teamed up with some of the country's finest musicians, and together they will offer a wide-ranging repertoire.

"For me, Lea is one of the greatest new singing talents in Danish jazz. Her vocal control and harmonic understanding are in a class of their own, and her improvisations always make one's ears prick up. At the same time, she is a skilled composer and lyricist who has written strong and moving lyrics for several of my compositions." - Mathias Heise

name: Paradise Jazz: Tom's Wild Years (DK/GB/US) | Copenhagen Jazz Festival
description:
Tom's Wild Years is a very special project. As the title suggests, it is a program of songs written by Tom Waits as well as some lyrics about this unique singer/songwriter.

Tom Waits is a great inspiration for me – and for an incredible number of other people. As a musician, I have listened to his music almost all my life. The raw sound, his crunchy voice, the strong stories and the musicians' ingenuity create a universe that continues to inspire me.
I have chosen pieces from almost all of his records, songs that are suitable for being arranged in ways that make the music ours and make room for the individual musicians in the septet. It is pointless to try to imitate Tom Waits' own versions, so I have cut and rearranged. But no matter what you do, Tom Waits' music always sounds like something only he could have come up with.

Bassist Henrik Simonsen and drummer Timothy Lutte are my first choices when it comes to putting together a competent and swinging rhythm group. We have played my own songs in the trio NOT MARRIED ANYMORE and they really know how to create calm and life at the same time when music has to groove.
Together with them you can hear Marie Louise Nitschky Schmidt on piano and organ. She has a lot of experience with singing and with the borderland between jazz and everything else.

The vibraphone was originally played by Bent Clausen, but this year it is my old friend Morten Grønvad who gives his all. The wind instruments are the English saxophone phenomenon Peter Corser and the Danish trumpet star Thomas Fryland.

name: Copenhagen Clarinet Choir + Henrik Pultz Melbye | Copenhagen Jazz Festival
description:
Copenhagen Clarinet Choir og Carolyn Goodwin

Irish musician Carolyn Goodwin presents a cycle of newly composed songs, originally written on guitar and now reimagined and transformed through the pulsating, interweaving textures of the Copenhagen Clarinet Choir.

Copenhagen Clarinet Choir is a new music ensemble that takes an egalitarian approach, where interdependent parts find an overall shape as organically as a living entity. Much like a choir, the individual voices of the six homogenous instruments are synergized, creating a warm, pulsating body of sound. The result is a profound timbral symbiosis, sculpted by the nuances of the clarinet.

The Irish woodwind player Carolyn Goodwin is a key figure in the Danish contemporary, experimental, and improvised music scene. Her compositional voice draws on minimalism, folk tradition, and modal improvisation, creating music that is both spacious and emotionally resonant. She founded the ensemble Copenhagen Clarinet Choir, with whom she released the album Organism on the label År & Dag in September 2022. Described as “craniosacral therapy for the ears,” Organism garnered widespread acclaim and international radio play and received an honorable mention in the "Best of 2022" list by the New York City Jazz Record.

Henrik Pultz Melbye

With saxophones and effects, Henrik Pultz Melbye transforms Xenon into a space where dreams emerge and time and thought dissolve.

On his latest solo release, Drømmene (The Dreams), saxophonist and composer Henrik Pultz Melbye explores his dreams—the places they take him and the emotions and memories they evoke. The music is an attempt to recreate the multifaceted feelings and images that dreams often unconsciously bring forth in him. The track titles, such as Stranden (The Beach), Skoven (The Forest), and Vejen (The Road), reference places that, in the dreams, conjure ambiguous emotions of hope, powerlessness, anxiety, and joy.

As a one-man band, he uses saxophones, EWI (a synthesizer saxophone), loops, and effects to create an ambient, cinematic world that spans from noise to meditative music. The music moves slowly, with no demand for direction or intention of resolution, offering a space where you don’t need to do anything but just be. Some might call it wellness music with an edge.

name: Salif Keita (ML) – CJF 2025
description:
One of modern West African popular music's most well-known voices, Salif Keita, is back in his most intimate format yet for this summer's Copenhagen Jazz Festival

Salif Keita (ML) – Copenhagen Jazz Festival 2025
Friday July 4, kl. 21:00 @ DR Koncerthuset, Koncertsalen
Tickets: https://bit.ly/cjf2025keitasale

●○●○●○●○●○●○●○●

Den verdensberømte maliske sanger og sangskriver Salif Keita annoncerede sit exit fra musikken i 2018, men er nu tilbage med et rent akustisk album, der viser hans gyldne stemme i sin allermest intime og rå form. Oplev afropop-kæmpen i DR Koncerthuset den første aften på Copenhagen Jazz Festival 2025.

Vestafrikanske Salif Keita meddelte efter albummet “Un Autre Blanc” (2018), at han nu ville hellige sig arbejdet med sin fond i arbejdet for rettigheder til folk med albinisme. Tidligere i år vendte han dog tilbage med albummet “So Kono” – hans første samling af rent akustiske sange spillet på guitar, cello og instrumenter fra Malis stolte griot-tradition som ngoni, kalabas og tama. Det anmelderroste album byder både på genfortolkninger af et par tidligere Keita-klassikere og en række nye sange, der præsenterer hans enestående stemme i et mere minimalistisk format. Når han vender tilbage til Copenhagen Jazz Festival i DR Koncerthuset, er det i samme form med en akustisk kvartet.

En helt særlig brobygning mellem genrer og traditioner har været en fast del af den nu 75-årige verdensstjernes lyd lige siden. I tidens løb er det blevet til samarbejder med folk som Wayne Shorter, Carlos Santana, Esperanza Spalding, Joe Zawinul, Bobby McFerrin og mange andre. Copenhagen Jazz Festival og DR Koncerthuset er stolte af at kunne præsentere “Afrikas gyldne stemme” i et unikt, intimt format til sommer.
